mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) over the past month signals inflationary pressure, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the correlation between CPI increases and subsequent FEDFUNDS tightening is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative investor sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the correlation between UNRATE increases and subsequent negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past two quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances despite the negative signal, or if the correlation between GDPC1 declines and subsequent negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or if the correlation between INDPRO increases and subsequent positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the correlation between PAYEMS declines and subsequent negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals a strengthening demand side of the economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or if the correlation between HOUST increases and subsequent positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low level of federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or if the correlation between low FEDFUNDS and subsequent positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and RSAFS both increase > 1% in 3 months
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or if the joint correlation between GDPC1, RSAFS increases and subsequent positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
